judge.reader: the product owner and the engineering lead deciding whether this scope is right for the pilot
questions: Does the problem statement name who has the problem and the pain, backed by the call-center and interview evidence?
Are success metrics given with the baseline the notes provide, without inventing a target the notes leave open?
Are non-goals stated (the parked ideas), and can each requirement be tested?
Does it stay at what and why, leaving technical design to engineering?
